title: K 个不同整数的子数组
summary: 统计恰好含 k 个不同整数的连续子数组数量。
insight: 恰好 k 种等于至多 k 种的子数组数减去至多 k-1 种；至多限制可用标准左右滑动窗口线性计数。
pitfalls: 每个右端贡献 right-left+1 个至多限制子数组
某值频次降为零时不同数计数才减少
k-1 可能为零但窗口算法仍适用

solutions.title: 不同数至多窗口作差
solutions.idea: 用两个单调滑动窗口得到精确种类数。
steps: 扩展 right，新值令 distinct++；超过 limit 时移动 left 并在频次归零时 distinct--

code.java: class Solution { public int subarraysWithKDistinct(int[] nums,int k){return atMost(nums,k)-atMost(nums,k-1);}private int atMost(int[] nums,int limit){Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();int left=0,distinct=0,count=0;for(int right=0;right<nums.length;right++){if(frequency.getOrDefault(nums[right],0)==0)distinct++;frequency.merge(nums[right],1,Integer::sum);while(distinct>limit){int value=nums[left++];frequency.put(value,frequency.get(value)-1);if(frequency.get(value)==0)distinct--;}count+=right-left+1;}return count;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun subarraysWithKDistinct(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int=atMost(nums,k)-atMost(nums,k-1);private fun atMost(nums:IntArray,limit:Int):Int{val frequency=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();var left=0;var distinct=0;var count=0;for(right in nums.indices){if((frequency[nums[right]]?:0)==0)distinct++;frequency[nums[right]]=(frequency[nums[right]]?:0)+1;while(distinct>limit){val value=nums[left++];frequency[value]=frequency[value]!!-1;if(frequency[value]==0)distinct--};count+=right-left+1};return count} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int atMost(vector<int>& nums,int limit){unordered_map<int,int> frequency;int left=0,distinct=0,count=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)nums.size();++right){if(frequency[nums[right]]++==0)++distinct;while(distinct>limit){int value=nums[left++];if(--frequency[value]==0)--distinct;}count+=right-left+1;}return count;}public:int subarraysWithKDistinct(vector<int>& nums,int k){return atMost(nums,k)-atMost(nums,k-1);} };
